summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.13/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.13 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 18, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 8¢ higher than a week ago, 19¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.58 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.91) and the highest in Superior ($4.35).
